arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Roy Dripps argued both statutes should apply.
He claimed the company used the Limited Liability Act improperly.
He stated this action destroys rights Congress granted to Lewis.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the oral argument session.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: James Lewis sued Lewis & Clark Marine for injuries. He claims the Jones Act grants him specific rights. The company argues the Limited Liability Act restricts its financial exposure. The Court must decide if these statutes conflict.
